1: // game.js – Canvas Escape (endless runner)
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
7:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600);
8: 
9:   // player (triangle) state
10:   const player = {
11:     x: W / 2,
12:     y: H - 30,
13:     size: 20,
14:     vy: 0,
15:     onGround: true,
16:   };
17: 
18:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
19:   const JUMP_SPEED = -12;
20: 
21:   // obstacles – simple rectangles
22:   const obstacles = [];
23:   const OBSTACLE_W = 40;
24:   const OBSTACLE_H = 20;
25:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 3;
26:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
27:   const OBSTACLE_INTERVAL = 90; // frames
28: 
29:   let gameOver = false;
30: 
31:   // Input handling
32:   const keys = {};
33:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
34:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
35: 
36:   function reset() {
37:     player.x = W / 2;
38:     player.y = H - 30;
39:     player.vy = 0;
40:     player.onGround = true;
41:     obstacles.length = 0;
42:     obstacleTimer = 0;
43:     gameOver = false;
44:   }
45: 
46:   function update() {
47:     if (gameOver) return;
48:     // player horizontal movement
49:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= 5;
50:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += 5;
51:     // keep within bounds
52:     player.x = Math.max(player.size, Math.min(W - player.size, player.x));
53: 
54:     // jump
55:     if (keys.ArrowUp && player.onGround) {
56:       player.vy = JUMP_SPEED;
57:       player.onGround = false;
58:     }
59:     // gravity
60:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
61:     player.y += player.vy;
62:     if (player.y >= H - 30) {
63:       player.y = H - 30;
64:       player.vy = 0;
65:       player.onGround = true;
66:     }
67: 
68:     // obstacles generation
69:     if (obstacleTimer-- <= 0) {
70:       obstacleTimer = OBSTACLE_INTERVAL;
71:       const x = Math.random() * (W - OBSTACLE_W);
72:       obstacles.push({ x, y: -OBSTACLE_H, w: OBSTACLE_W, h: OBSTACLE_H });
73:     }
74:     // move obstacles
75:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
76:       const o = obstacles[i];
77:       o.y += OBSTACLE_SPEED;
78:       // remove off‑screen
79:       if (o.y > H) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
80:     }
81: 
82:     // collision detection (simple AABB against player bounding box)
83:     const pBox = {
84:       left: player.x - player.size,
85:       right: player.x + player.size,
86:       top: player.y - player.size,
87:       bottom: player.y + player.size,
88:     };
89:     for (const o of obstacles) {
90:       if (
91:         pBox.right > o.x &&
92:         pBox.left < o.x + o.w &&
93:         pBox.bottom > o.y &&
94:         pBox.top < o.y + o.h
95:       ) {
96:         gameOver = true;
97:         break;
98:       }
99:     }
100:   }
101: 
102:   function draw() {
103:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
104:     // player – triangle pointing up
105:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0b79d0';
106:     ctx.beginPath();
107:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y - player.size);
108:     ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.size, player.y + player.size);
109:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.size, player.y + player.size);
110:     ctx.closePath();
111:     ctx.fill();
112:     // obstacles
113:     ctx.fillStyle = '#c33';
114:     for (const o of obstacles) {
115:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
116:     }
117:     // game over overlay
118:     if (gameOver) {
119:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
120:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
121:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
122:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
123:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
124:       ctx.fillText('Game Over – Press R to Restart', W / 2, H / 2);
125:     }
126:   }
127: 
128:   function loop() {
129:     update();
130:     draw();
131:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
132:   }
133: 
134:   // restart on R key when game over
135:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
136:     if (gameOver && e.key === 'r') reset();
137:   });
138: 
139:   reset();
140:   loop();
141: })();
